COURSE MATERIALS
MyLab MIS access is required for this course.

GRADING
Your grade will be made up of the following:

MyLab MIS: 15%

Assignments: 39%

Outcomes Assessment: 1%

Quizzes: 25%

Comprehensive final exam: 20%

Grades will be assigned on the University’s standard grading scale (90% is an A, 80% is a B, 70% is a C, 60% is a D, and below
60% is an F). Your final grade will be based on what you have earned and is not negotiable upon semester’s end.

LATE WORK
Late work is not accepted without prior approval.
